refinement.detail: Searched, found none applicable to this ticket's model delta, because there is no model delta: specs/tickets/EV-01/current == desired, byte for byte. The refinement search WAS run against the fixtures, which is where this ticket's representation decisions live, and it produced three recorded outcomes rather than a model change. (1) The decomposable fixture was almost built on the owner's two-component probe model; a two-component partition has exactly one component pair, that pair is ported, and `unfalsifiable_coherence` fires on every run over it -- a fixture that cannot produce a divergence cannot be the positive test for a divergence check. One variable and one action were added so that ingest <-> ledger is unported. Measured: Q = 0.133, all three criteria met, divergence detectable, and the twin's four divergences are therefore findable. (2) The corpus arm was almost built as one adapter mapping with the provider assertion behind a flag; that is a suppression key with better manners, so it was built as TWO declared mappings instead, and a reader of the mapping can now see which instrument produced a number. (3) A synthetic Jenga was almost dropped in favour of this repository's own model, which IS one; it was kept because the real one refuses at the model stage and so can never exercise the `unfalsifiable_coherence` refusal against a code side. Each of the three is written down in the fixture READMEs rather than left as an unexplained shape.

kill_rate.evidence: DELIBERATE. EV-01 built a six-fault catalog (examples/validation/ex4_pipeline_coherent/seeded_faults.toml) with a predicted detector and a predicted measurement arm per fault, and ran the CONTROL only -- both arms green on the unmutated program, 330 cases, exit 0. Measuring the mutants is EV-02's job. A fixture author who scores his own instrument has deleted the measurement, so `not_run` is the honest value here and the catalog is the deliverable.

ticket.model_delta_result: ZERO, as planned and verified: `diff -r specs/tickets/EV-01/current specs/tickets/EV-01/desired` is empty (specs/tickets/EV-01/results/zero-model-delta.txt), TLC green on ticket current (32,122,220 generated / 1,292,951 distinct / depth 26, 0 left on queue), spec-unit tests pass for both targets. No action was invented to produce a delta: EV-01 builds the instrument that will judge this epic, and changing the program the instrument measures would have made the fixtures a measurement of EV-01's own edits.
ticket.objective: Refresh the validation surface so the next run measures THIS epic, not the last one. The three existing examples were aimed at the descriptor, the intuition doc, and the fitness functions; none of them exercises case modules or architecture coherence. Add at least one example whose production code is deliberately incoherent -- the enterprise-Jenga fixture: shared mutable state, no single writer, every command reaching every module -- so the reflexion check has something real to find, alongside a coherent counterpart so a false positive is visible. Bring the existing examples up to date with the shipped surface. Commit PREDICTIONS BEFORE any run, per the MF-037 protocol, naming the degenerate paths this epic can produce: case modules quietly replacing a view's corpus, and a reflexion map drawn to make the code look clean.
